Explanation: The field is mandatory present if gnss-id is set to sbas. It is absent otherwise.

The field is optionally present, Need R, if si-BroadcastStatus is set to notBroadcasting for any SI-message included in schedulingInfoList or any SI-message containing type1 SIB included in schedulingInfoList2. It is absent otherwise.
The field is mandatory present if the SIB type is different from SIB6, SIB7 or SIB8. For SIB6, SIB7 and SIB8 it is absent.
The field is mandatory present if the SIB type is type1. For type2 it is absent.

The field is optionally present, Need R, if supplementaryUplink is configured in ServingCellConfigCommonSIB and if si-BroadcastStatus is set to notBroadcasting for any SI-message included in schedulingInfoList or any SI-message containing type1 SIB included in schedulingInfoList2. It is absent otherwise.

The field is optionally present, Need R, if initialUplinkBWP-RedCap is configured in UplinkConfigCommonSIB and if si-BroadcastStatus is set to notBroadcasting for any SI-message included in schedulingInfoList or any SI-message containing type1 SIB included in schedulingInfoList2. It is absent otherwise.
